sanctioned exception to "all /v1 traffic goes through
is a `Content-Disposition: attachment` body — JSON *or* PDF bytes —
and the mutator unconditionally JSON.parse()s. It reuses the same
configured origin and the same `credentials: 'include'` discipline,
and it is drawn here rather than hidden inside the screen precisely
because an undrawn second egress is how "one call site" quietly
hard-delete Profile · anonymise the audit rows to an
irreversible tombstone (the Art. 30 record survives, the
person-link does not) · delete the better-auth User
(Session/Account cascade). Rows under an active LegalHold
are exempt. All-or-nothing, never a partial teardown.
verified session OR signed guest cookie
All /v1 access is scoped by the trusted userId the UserContextGuard
establishes (ADR-0007/0012) — a verified better-auth session or an
HMAC-signed guest cookie, never a client-supplied identity.
better-auth (ADR-0009) mounts *behind* that seam, not around it.
@steuereule/core is the single home of deterministic rules
(validators, cockpitRange), imported by both api and frontend.
